mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,buyer_deposit,buyer_deposit_status,status FROM t_orders WHERE status='requesting' AND intent_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT id,buyer_id,buyer_deposit,buyer_deposit_status,status FROM t_orders WHERE status='negotiating' AND negotiation_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET status='closed',closed_reason=#{reason},buyer_deposit_status=CASE WHEN buyer_deposit_status='frozen' THEN 'refunded' ELSE buyer_deposit_status END,settled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{oldStatus}
UPDATE t_deposits SET status='refunded',reason='订单超时取消',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='frozen' AND party_role='buyer'
UPDATE t_orders SET shipping_fee_status='agreed',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE shipping_fee_status IN ('proposed','countered') AND shipping_fee_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id,publisher_id,title FROM t_demands WHERE status='open' AND pk_deadline IS NOT NULL AND pk_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_demands SET status='awarded_pending',pk_result=CAST(#{result} AS JSON) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='open'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_demands WHERE status='open' AND deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND pk_deadline IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_demands SET status='closed',pk_deadline=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='open'
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,out_trade_no,amount_cents,status,transaction_id FROM t_pay_orders WHERE out_trade_no=#{tradeNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_pay_orders SET status='paid',transaction_id=#{transactionId},paid_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending'
